as it is written: 'and Moses heard the people weeping by their families' (Num 11:10) -- over the matters of their families
for there is no marriage contract in which they do not cast a quarrel
every mitzva for which Israel gave themselves over to death in the hour of the kingdom's decree, such as idolatry and circumcision, is still firmly held in their hand
and every mitzva for which Israel did not give themselves over to death in the hour of the kingdom's decree, such as tefillin, is still weak in their hand
R' Yannai: tefillin require a clean body, like Elisha Man of Wings
what is it? Abaye: that he not break wind in them
Rava: that he not sleep in them
once the wicked kingdom decreed against Israel that whoever dons tefillin on his head, they would pierce his brain
and Elisha would don tefillin and go out to the market
[the official] said to him: what is in your hand? He said to him: dove's wings

an official saw him; he ran before him and [the official] ran after him; when he reached him, he took them off his head and held them in his hand ... he opened his hand and dove's wings were found in it
why do they call him Elisha Man of Wings? ... therefore they would call him Man of Wings
why dove's wings, and not other birds? because the community of Israel is likened to a dove

as this dove -- its wings protect it, so Israel -- the mitzvot protect them
